carried_findings.status: open, scheduled for the start of W3 by operator decision
carried_findings.summary: LearnedObservationIntake refuses a re-offer of the same governed outcome at a different moment, contradicting its own documented crash-safety.

corpus.regeneration: byte-identical; task and candidate identities are uuid5 over template and seed
corpus.rights: Apache-2.0, project-owned, verified per task with an evidence hash

corpus_contract_verified_in_the_real_san.note: The published suite passing on the broken code is the property the sprint rests on: only the hidden suite discriminates.

deviations.observed: Experience Compiler trajectory compilation and Corpus Factory routing are still unproven.
deviations.reason: Both are W3 work items (S21C3-034, S21C3-035).
deviations.risk_accepted: Unchanged from W1 and still the largest unproven integration. W3 must start with them, together with the W1-F1 intake fix.
deviations.subject: backlog section 6.1 steps 8 and 9, carried from W1

findings.action: checkpoint was redesigned around a different second edge case (the history is trimmed to a limit) and a non-mutating baseline. Re-verified in the sandbox; the near-clone report is now empty across all five variants.
findings.impact: They sat in different repository groups, so a group-aware split could have separated two structurally identical tasks and leaked one into the evaluation of the other.
findings.observed: The AST and token normalizers reported state_idempotency.checkpoint and state_idempotency.merge_settings as near-clones: both baselines were 'call a mutating method on the first argument and return it', and both shared the 'does not mutate the input' edge case.

findings.action: A control path is now a control token only when it is absent from the visible files. A name collision is not a leak.
findings.impact: A detector whose output is 90 false positives is a detector nobody reads.
findings.observed: The scanner reported 90 control leaks that were all the filename 'conftest.py', which exists in both the control bundle and the workspace.

findings.action: The header is emitted, and every candidate is asserted to round-trip through parse_unified_diff and apply_file_patch back to its own declared source.
findings.impact: 120 candidates would have been recorded as executions of patches the patch plane could not apply.
findings.observed: difflib.unified_diff emits file headers but not the 'diff --git' line the repository's own parser keys on, so every generated candidate patch was unreadable by the patch plane.

leakage_and_shortcuts.detector_self_check: The normalizer is asserted to collapse a renamed clone and to separate genuinely different shapes, so a detector that finds nothing is distinguishable from one that detects nothing.
leakage_and_shortcuts.universal_patch_note: Concatenating every declared answer trivially solves the corpus because each task's own answer is in the pile. The adversary implemented here is the meaningful one: a correction written for one task, dropped into a sibling task's file, must not make the sibling pass.
